column1: # The analogue map of 0x821CAA50, derived cycle 1318.
# r20 IS ZERO THROUGHOUT: `li r20,0x0` at 821caa88 is the only write to it in the
# whole 744-instruction function -- the two other appearances, 821caabc and
# 821cab8c, are stores OF r20, not to it -- and r20 is non-volatile, so the two
# API callees must preserve it. Every slot offset below therefore reads
# (bit + 3) * 4 with no base, which is what cycle 1316 assumed and could not check.
# Each axis owns ONE slot, shared by its two halves: the positive half is scaled
# straight, the negative half is negated (821cb044 neg r9,r9). One signed float
# per axis.
# columns: buffer_off device_off half mask bit slot read_at
0x2A
0x2C
0x2E
# Two further masks appear earlier in the function -- 0x4000 (bit 14, slot 0x44)
# and 0x8000 (bit 15, slot 0x48). Their sources are not these eight halves and
# are not yet read; the triggers at device +0x4A/+0x4B are the obvious guess and
# are recorded as a guess.
# The float array therefore reaches at least record+0x5B, which corrects cycle
# 1316's estimate of +0x53. It is still inside the 0x84 the frame stage clears.
